violated_contract: A verified Stripe schedule delivery must remain retryable when retrieving or durably persisting its entitlement fails; returning HTTP 200 must not permanently discard a transient billing update.
canonical_prevention: At the schedule webhook adapter boundary, classify transient read/write failures as retryable HTTP 503 under the default-off billing-ingestion rollout gate. The shared event ledger only acknowledges after a successful handler return. Missing/deleted owners keep their intentional acknowledgement. Behavioral contract tests exercise both schedule completion and cancellation, read/write failures, flag-off legacy behavior, flag-on retry receipts, successful duplicate suppression, and deleted-owner acknowledgement.
